subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should Docker sandboxes support preinstalled skills through a verified backend-owned root or manifest, or should disabling synchronization mean local skills are unavailable?
rationale: The choice defines a new public configuration and sandbox trust contract; implementation review cannot decide whether OpenClaw should attest container-side skill identity or intentionally disable local skill use.

options.title: Define verified preinstall contract
options.body: Accept the capability only with a Docker-owned root or manifest that verifies and advertises readable skill files.

options.title: Make skip mode disable skills
options.body: Keep a simpler optimization but enforce and document that no local skill instructions are available when synchronization is disabled.

options.title: Decline the new option
options.body: Retain automatic materialization as the only supported local-skill contract and use existing allowlists for no-skills deployments.

recommendation.title: Define verified preinstall contract
recommendation.body: Accept the capability only with a Docker-owned root or manifest that verifies and advertises readable skill files.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans sandbox backend guarantees, configuration policy, and operator documentation reflected in their recent work.
